title: Fix the application.json icon configuration so the uploaded Support360 logo is r
description: Fix the Support360 application icon. The uploaded Support360 logo in application properties is not appearing in the runtime. The default support agent icon is still displayed. Configure the application so the uploaded Support360 logo is used as the application icon in the runtime, navigation/header. Do not change any other functionality. Save and deploy the updated icon configuration.
